questions.question: What shape does ArrayDataset return for one synthetic CIFAR image after __getitem__?
options: (32,32,3) with a one-hot NumPy label
(1,3,32,32) with a string label
(3,32,32) with a scalar integer label
(10,32,32) with a floating image index
questions.explanation: The dataset converts HWC NumPy data to a contiguous tensor and permutes it to CHW, while int(Y[i]) is returned as the label.

questions.question: What does mixup_batch do to two examples when lambda is 0.7?
options: Chooses x1 and discards every label
Averages only the class indices as an integer
Adds 0.7 to every pixel without changing the target
Forms 0.7*x1+0.3*x2 and the same convex combination of their one-hot labels
questions.explanation: Mixup interpolates both inputs and one-hot targets using the sampled lambda and a shuffled partner in the batch.

questions.question: Why does soft_cross_entropy receive soft_targets rather than integer class indices?
options: Mixup labels are fractional class distributions
The model has no final logits
Cross-entropy cannot use log probabilities
The DataLoader returns images as labels
questions.explanation: The loss computes -sum(target*log_softmax(logits)); this supports the convex label vectors produced by mixup.

questions.question: What spatial size does random_crop(pad=4) return for a 32x32 image?
questions.explanation: The image is padded to 40x40, then a 32x32 window is selected, preserving the classifier's input size.

questions.question: In evaluate, what does cm[t,p] += 1 record?
options: One parameter update for class p
The number of training batches for class t
One example whose true class is t and predicted class is p
A pixel-level intersection over union
questions.explanation: Rows represent true classes and columns represent predictions, allowing per-class precision and recall to be derived.

questions.question: What happens to the learning rate in the main classification loop after each epoch?
options: It is reset to 0.05 before every batch
It is replaced by the validation accuracy
It is multiplied by the batch size
CosineAnnealingLR advances one scheduler step
questions.explanation: The code reads the current rate, trains and evaluates, then calls scheduler.step() once per epoch.
